question: Which neighbouring country of India is the world's only carbon-negative country?
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Bhutan'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhutan has more than** 70% of its land covered with trees and forests**.
 
• Bhutan's **main resource for electricity is Hydropower**.
 
• Bhutan is the **world's first carbon-negative country**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Burning fossil fuels and our day-to-day activities lead to carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, which makes the planet hot, also known as the Greenhouse Effect. 
 
 
• The world's oceans and plant life absorb carbon dioxide to create balance.
